summary:
Completed Implementation Plan for Notification Center Refactoring & UX Modernization:
- Removed intrusive bottom-right toast stack and continuous auto-simulation loop
- Implemented persistent TopBar Bell icon with live unread badge counter
- Created top-anchored NotificationDropdown with triage filter tabs (All, Alerts, Activity, System), Mark all as read, and Clear all
- Refactored transient action feedback into sleek, auto-dismissing top-center pills that silently log to bell history
- Fully verified with TypeScript and applet compilation
